text:
support_jen: Customer (org org-992) reports promo code shows as AVAILABLE in dashboard but API returns 410 "code expired or deactivated" when they try to apply it. Customer pasted request id req_0a9c3 and says they just reissued the code from the partner team yesterday.

support_jen: here's the API error payload they sent: ```{
  "error": {
    "code": 410,
    "message": "Promo code deactivated"
  }
}```

sam_ops: can you paste the exact promo string the customer used? also which environment (prod vs staging)?

support_jen: code they tried: FALLBACK-REISSUE-2026. Environment: prod. customer claims dashboard shows 1 redemption left.

lucas_eng: curious — the claim-service has a deactivated_by_admin flag; if that's toggled we return 410 even if dashboard cache is stale. pulling logs for req_0a9c3 now.

lucas_eng: log snippet: `promo_id=pm_87f deactivated_by_admin=true deactivated_at=2026-03-15T02:12:01Z`

billing_maya: we did a bulk deactivation of legacy partner promos yesterday while reissuing new codes; possible overlap. Will check whether pm_87f was in the wrong batch.

support_jen: customer insists the code was reissued to them this morning by partner-svc. forwarded their partner confirmation email.

lucas_eng: quick repro steps for ops:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/promo/apply \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" \ 
  -d '{"org_id":"org-992","code":"FALLBACK-REISSUE-2026"}'
```

lucas_eng: running the apply flow in prod against promo_id pm_87f returns 410 same as customer. Looks like reissue created a new code but DB reconcile left the old promo row deactivated. dashboard UI pulls a cached availability object which didn't refresh.

billing_maya: confirmed -- pm_87f was included in yesterday's deactivation CSV by mistake. Partner reissue created pm_9ab but customer used the old pm_87f. We're going to: 1) re-enable pm_87f for one redemption, 2) run a reconcile to update dashboard cache.

support_jen: can we do a manual credit meanwhile? customer is urgent.

billing_maya: applying one-off credit equal to promo value now and will tag customer account. ticket #INC-12477. I'll also notify partner ops to resend the new code to the customer.

support_jen: thanks! I'll reply to customer with interim credit and ETA for fix. :thumbsup:

lucas_eng: follow-up action for engineering: add a reconcile job to reconcile claim-service deactivation state with dashboard cache every 10m (or invalidate cache on deactivation event). filing ENG-2026.

support_jen: noted, I've told the customer credit applied and new code is being re-sent. closing loop once partner confirms.

billing_maya: partner confirmed resend at 2026-03-16T18:10Z. promo-bot: deactivation rollback performed for pm_87f for 1 redemption.

support_jen: customer confirmed they were able to apply the new code. marking resolved. :white_check_mark:
